test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 30 Jan 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.
solution:
The correct answer is **"by."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The preposition **"by"** is used to indicate the agent or means of something happening.
 
• In this case, it is the means by which something is being selected.
 
• We use **followed by** to say what comes after something else in a list or ordered set of things.
 
 
• **Example**: *Potatoes are still the most popular food, **followed by**__ white bread.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is** option 1.**

Correct passage:

Dandelion is a widely distributed weed of the daisy family, __with__ a rosette of leaves and large bright yellow flowers followed __**by**__ globular heads of seeds with downy tufts. I also reminded them that April is designated as the Month of ______ (3) ______ Military Child. Not many would know that 15 April is the day when we wear purple, or so to say, we ‘purple ______ (4) ______’ to express our solidarity and support ______ (5) ______ the strength and sacrifices of our children, while their fathers are deployed at Siachen Glacier, deserts and on our borders.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• The preposition **"with"** is used to indicate association or accompaniment, which does not fit the context of the sentence.
 
• The preposition "along" is used to indicate movement or progress in a particular direction, which is not applicable here.
 
• The conjunction** "since"** is used to indicate a point in time or a duration of time, which is not relevant to the sentence.
